messages:
incident-bot: [AUTOPAGE] PagerDuty -> inference-gateway-prod fired: 5xx error rate > 6% (1m)
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-4321 created and routed to on-call: @maria.garcia :rotating_light:
maria.garcia: acked. I'm on it, grabbing context.
alex.kim: seeing surge in EU-WEST1, tail of requests show `502` and `504` from gateway -> model-backend. Noted spikes at 10:02-10:04 UTC.
ops-bot: correlated metric: `http.server.errors.percent` from gateway increased from 0.4% -> 6.3% in 60s. CPU on frontends normal, backend pod restarts + OOMKilled in the last 3m.
alex.kim: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T10:03:21Z gateway inference-gateway-prod request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream=10.1.4.22: read timeout
2026-03-14T10:03:26Z model-backend pod/model-qp-2 restarted reason=OOMKilled
```
maria.garcia: runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-backend-5xx|runbook: inference backend 5xx>. Starting mitigation steps now.
alex.kim: quick mitigation plan:
- scale model-backend deployment to +50% for eu-west1
- enable fallback model-variant `gpt-small-quant` for latency-sensitive routes
- throttle large batch requests from customers with high qps
maria.garcia: running `kubectl -n prod scale deployment model-backend --replicas=6 --selector=region=eu-west1` now
ops-bot: command accepted, scaling rollout started. pods -> 3 -> 6
maria.garcia: enabling variant fallback via config: `routes->inference->fallback_variant: gpt-small-quant` (will affect 10% of traffic by routing policy)
alex.kim: also pushing temporary circuit-breaker on upstream: `upstream.timeout=3s` and reduce max concurrent requests per-connection to 8
tj: FYI I'm in 15 minutes, happy to take next handoff if still hot. @maria.garcia want me to prep rollback of recent deploy? :eyes:
maria.garcia: yes please, keep rollback ready but don't trigger unless errors persist after scaling+fallback (give 5-10m). I'll monitor.
ops-bot: metric update +2m: error rate dropping -> 3.1%. Latency slightly up but stable.
alex.kim: confirmed backend pod OOM pattern from new quantized-serve process. Found large batch requests from a single customer (cust-998) causing memory spike.
maria.garcia: throttled cust-998 via rate-limiter: `ratelimit apply cust-998 50r/s` — effect immediate.
ops-bot: after throttle + scale + fallback, error rate now 0.8% (5m window). Rolling back throttle in 10m if stable for 15m.
maria.garcia: paging notes for follow-up: root cause appears to be a combination of a recent model-serving change that increases memory per batch + a large unexpected burst from cust-998. Postmortem required. Creating internal ticket: INT-5678.
tj: I'll take next monitoring window and prepare a short postmortem draft. Also will add a mitigation to runbook: auto-fallback threshold + per-customer soft throttles.
alex.kim: thanks. tagging SRE oncall rotation for visibility: @tj @maria.garcia :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026-4321 acknowledged by maria.garcia at 2026-03-14T10:05:12Z. Escalation suspended.
maria.garcia: marking as resolved in 20m if no regression. Will update incident channel and attach timeline + logs.
ops-bot: note: customers impacted ~2 significant customers (cust-998 and cust-1012) with partial request failures. Support ticket created ST-3344.
alex.kim: final note: temporary mitigations in place — scale, fallback, throttle. Need code fix to reduce memory per-batch and add defensive batching limits.
maria.garcia: resolving pager now but leaving monitoring alert active. thanks team. :heart:
